text: Visitors have noted issues with signage and accessibility, particularly regarding handicap parking and transportation from the lot to the entrance. Several reviews criticized the use of AI in exhibits, describing it as poorly executed and detracting from the experience. Some visitors were frustrated by the timed entry system, reporting long waits and the need to purchase tickets in advance without clear communication. Food options in the café received negative comments for limited and unsatisfactory choices. Despite these concerns, many found the architecture and interactive exhibits engaging.
